Consultation.title: Consultation
Consultation.description: Client consultation requests and detailed budget quotation enquiries.

email.description: Email address of the client (or 'Not provided').

message.description: Project enquiry message or attached estimate summary.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was submitted.

BudgetCalculation.title: BudgetCalculation
BudgetCalculation.description: Complete NRB Home Budget Planner submission with mandatory client contact details, all room/service selections, and computed budget estimate.

sessionId.description: Client session identifier grouping progressive snapshots of the same planner session.

stage.description: Planner stage when this snapshot was saved (e.g., step1-completed, step2-spaces, step3-services, estimate-viewed, pdf-downloaded, whatsapp-clicked, consultation-clicked, quote-submitted).

name.description: Mandatory full name of the visitor using the budget calculator.

phone.description: Mandatory phone or WhatsApp number of the visitor.

notes.description: Optional project notes or possession timeline.

homeProfile.description: Step 1 home configuration (propertyType, bhk, carpetArea, location, customLocation, propertyStatus, projectType).

rooms.description: Step 2 space selections (kitchen, rooms, paint, falseCeiling, electrical, washroom, living).

additionalServices.description: Step 3 additional services toggles (flooring, plumbing, civil, custom-furniture).

plumbingWashrooms.description: Number of washrooms configured for plumbing work.

needDesignGuidance.description: Whether the user requested NRB DESIGN coordinator guidance.

estimate.description: Computed estimate totals, timeline, scopeSummary, breakdown, and summaryText.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the planner snapshot was recorded.

/consultations/{consultationId}.description: Public write-only consultation and quotation submissions.

/budget_calculations/{calculationId}.description: Public write-only NRB Home Budget Planner records storing user contact details, every selected option, and calculated estimates.
